video_title: Knicks Having GREATEST Playoff Run in NBA History???

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns is playing with incredible impact for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: He's attacking his feet, he's attacking his chest, he's attacking his length.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: We have to give Karl-Anthony Towns credit. As much criticism as he has gotten over the years, and specifically this year with him not knowing this role, look at how pivotal he is for the New York Knicks right now. The way that he's playing, going about business, hasn't given anybody any clear board material, just going out and whipping Victor Wembanyama's ass. He's attacking his feet, he's attacking his chest, he's attacking his length. I think that's the difference in this series than last.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Karl-Anthony Towns has been incredible this series, truly, truly dominant.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns's massive impact on the Knicks' playoff success
quotes.excerpt: He's plus 25 in the finals and Jalen Brunson is minus 4.
quotes.quote: I love the impact he's having. Even the emotion there, how he's playing physical defensively, he's making it tough on him. He's forcing him to take bad shots, he's settling, he's causing a lot of turnovers that Victor Wembanyama is having that are not usually his norm. And also, I'm not a big plus-minus guy, he's plus 25 in the finals and Jalen Brunson is minus 4. Take that however you want, but that is impact, that is winning basketball, and he is doing all those things on both sides of the basketball to impact this series.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges is a versatile and essential glue guy for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: He's such a situational type role player where he can have big nights.
quotes.quote: I think he's such a situational type role player where he can have big nights. He can blend it in, he can disappear, but he's always going to be consistently versatile in his defense. He's always going to guard the best player on the other team. When you have a Jalen Brunson, when you have a Karl-Anthony Towns, his numbers aren't going to blow you out of the water. He's such an important piece. Him and OG are interchangeable, they're versatile, they can get out in transition, they can switch one through five.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges provides consistent value beyond his offensive production
quotes.excerpt: He's a Swiss army knife. Even if he doesn't go on a run, he's still going to give you.
quotes.quote: He's a Swiss army knife. Even if he doesn't go on a run that he did offensively last night, he's still going to give you six rebounds, six assists. He'll take on any defensive job that you give him on a defensive end. Now he's a threat on the offensive end, and that's what you need. Usually we're talking about Jalen Brunson, we're talking about OG, we're talking about Karl-Anthony Towns. Now if you can get Mikal Bridges to go on an offensive end, that makes the New York Knicks twice as dangerous.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges's value is high but not worth five first-round picks
quotes.excerpt: I don't agree as far as him being worth five picks.
quotes.quote: He's a hell of a player, a perfect glue guy. I don't agree as far as him being worth five picks. When I think about a player worth five first-round picks, I view them numbers-wise a lot differently. But as far as his impact and value to this Knicks team, he's everything this Knicks team needs. When he's playing at a high level, the Knicks play at a high level. This is a guy that's shown that he's always available, which is a skill in itself.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks are currently playing the best basketball in NBA history
quotes.excerpt: This is one of the greatest runs in the history of the NBA.
quotes.quote: This is one of the hottest teams ever, and they are peaking and maximizing. They are playing their best basketball at the absolute ideal best time. This is one of the greatest runs in the history of the NBA. If they can finish this off, what a story, what a season.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks have transformed into a highly confident and prepared playoff team
quotes.excerpt: They're one of the most confident and prepared teams that we've seen in a very long time.
quotes.quote: They went through a losing streak, they went through a winning streak, another losing streak to another winning streak, now to having a historic playoff run. They've played so well, you kind of forgot about the Atlanta Hawks and what they did to the Hawks in that game by winning by 50 plus points in a pivotal game six. They're one of the most confident and prepared teams that we've seen in a very long time in the playoffs. The Knicks have made the world stand still and respect them at this point.
